error: a host prompt exceeds the locked context budget
measured_cause: The catalog bounded contexts by complete UTF-8 sentences but did not preflight the composed prompts with the exact LayerCake tokenizer. Seventeen records in budget index 1 tokenize to at least the locked 256-token training sequence length, leaving no supervised response token.
bounded_repair: Preserve the immutable source artifact; preflight every selected row with the exact parent tokenizer; exclude and enumerate only prompts whose token count is greater than or equal to max_tokens; retain complete capability coverage; and reapply the preregistered 0.60-times step formula to the compatible record count.
claim_boundary: The single in-memory optimizer update was discarded and is not a candidate. This failure provides no quality credit and does not authorize a data, architecture, decoder, or gate change.
